spans.s: Non,Ⓐ(a prefix) Ex. by a, an; ‘n(on)-acceptance’ aparigrahaH, asvIkAraH; ‘n(on)-appearance, n(on)-attendance’ anupasTiti f., asaMniDAnaM, adarSanaM, avidyamAnatA; ‘n(on)-attainment’ aprApti f., alABaH; ‘n(on)-attention’ anavaDAnaM, pramAdaH; ‘n(on)-chalant’ nirutsuka, anape(ve)kza, udAsIna, niHspfha; [] ‘n(on)-compliance’ ananuroDaH, ananuvartanaM, viroDaH; ‘n(on)-conductor’ avAhakraH, anA-yakaH; ‘n(on)-conformist’ ananuroDin m., ananuvartin; sAmAnyaDarmaviroDin m. matAMtaragrAhin m. ‘n(on)-comformity’ ananuroDaH, matAMtaragrahaRaM; ‘n(on)-descript’ avarRita, akftala-kzaRa; ‘n(on)-resistance’ apratIkAraH; &c. &c.

Noon,Ⓒs.Ⓓ(‘N(oon)-time’) maDyAhnaH, maDyadinaM, maDyAhnakAlaH.
Ⓔa.ⒹmADyAhnika (kI f.), mADyaMdina (nI f.).

None,Ⓒa.Ⓓna kaScit, na kopi, na kaScana, na kAcit, &c.; oft. ex. by na with other words; ‘n(one) other’ nAnya, netara; ‘n(one) but’ eva; (with compar. adj.) na kimapi, na Izadapi, na manAgapi, na stokamapi.

Nonentity,Ⓒs.ⒹaBAvaH, asaMBavaH, asattA, asadBAvaH, SUnyatA.
Ⓑ
 2 SUnyaM, avastu n.; ‘he is a n(onentity) in the kingdom’ rAjye akiMci-tkaraH saH.

Nonplus,Ⓒv. i.ⒹkuMW 10, vi-, muh c., Aku-lIkf 8 U, niruttarIkf.
Ⓔs.ⒹkuMWatA, vi-, mohaH, niruttaratA, agati f., nirupAyatA.
Ⓝ[Nonplus]ed,Ⓒa.ⒹkuMWita, nirupAya, gatihIna, agatika, mUQa, niruttara.

Nonsense,Ⓒs.ⒹasaMbadDa-anarTaka-vAkyaM-vacanaM-BAzaRaM, mfzAkaTA-AlApaH, pralApaH, jalpitaM, asatyaM, ayATArTyaM, anarTakaM; ‘to talk n(onsense)’ pralap 1 P, prajalp 1 P, asaMbadDaM BAz 1 A; ‘talking n(onsense)’ asaMbadDapralApin, vAcAla, jalpaka.
ⓃNonsensical,Ⓒa.ⒹasaM-badDa, asaMgata, anarTaka, nirarTaka, mfzArTaka, ayaTArTa.
Ⓝ[Nonsensical]ly,Ⓒadv.ⒹanarTakaM, asaMbadDaM, asaM-gataM, mfzA, vfTA.
Ⓝ[Nonsensical]ness,Ⓒs.ⒹasaMbadDatA, &c.
Nonsuited,Ⓒa.Ⓓnazwa-hIna-vAda, avasanna, arTAd hIna; ‘to be n(onsuited)’ avasad 1 P, arTAt-vAdAd hA pass.
